text:
```yaml
name: OSV Vulnerability Scan

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  osv-scan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Flutter
      uses: subosito/flutter-action@v1
      with:
        flutter-version: '3.0.5'

    - name: Set up Dart SDK
      uses: actions/setup-dart@v2
      with:
        channel: 'stable'
        version: '2.14.0'

    - name: Analyze Flutter project
      run: flutter analyze

    - name: Format Dart files
      run: dart format .

    - name: Run OSV Scanner
      run: |
        pip install osv-scanner
        osv-scanner --project-root .
```
